integrity: Finite exact-arithmetic checks support, but do not replace, the all-curves positivity proof. The resolution and small examples are credited to the primary source.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers and two-dimensional matrix pencils only; depends on the published explicit resolution, uses characteristic-zero base-point freeness; full prior-literature exhaustiveness and independent validation are not established.
title: Weak log del Pezzo and anticanonical classification of Schubert surfaces of matrix pencils
